# Contributing

Use the affected component's terms in LICENSES/README.md. Preserve attribution,
notices and provenance; never fabricate DCO signoffs for another person or an
assistant. Discuss substantial features and keep PRs focused.

Read AGENTS.md and docs/DEVELOPMENT.md. Use normal npm commands, relevant whole
test files and independent review for meaningful security/commerce boundaries.
The old SQLite implementation and bespoke release checker are retired under
ADR-0093. Historical planning/source inventories are not current release
clearance. Dependency/license and production qualification remain separate.

Never commit credentials, private merchant settings or raw evidence. Hosted CI
is unavailable due to cost restrictions; use local checks and do not dispatch it.
